Hamas Doesn’t Want Deal, Will be ‘Hunted Down’: Trump
U.S. and Israeli negotiating teams left Doha, Qatar, this week following unsuccessful negotiations with Hamas.
Save
Print
President Donald Trump speaks to the press before departing for Scotland from the White House on July 25, 2025.
Madalina Kilroy/The Epoch Times

President Donald Trump said on July 25 that Hamas does not want a deal and that the terrorist group will be “hunted down.”
“Hamas didn’t want to make a deal,” he told reporters before departing for Scotland. “I think what’s going to happen is they are going to be hunted down.”
